rows.validation_method: Validate that every consume folder is mapped to extraction posture, evidence limits, and compiled destinations.
rows.blocker_or_dependency: Requires inbox consume packets to remain inside the parent repo and machine-readable enough for bounded mapping.

rows.validation_method: Validate that extract vs enrich posture is explicit for every consume family and that transcript-heavy inputs stay bounded.
rows.blocker_or_dependency: Requires first-party consume packets and stable folder naming.
do_not_promote_notes: Extraction mapping alone does not promote transcript-derived workflow claims.

rows.validation_method: Validate that every source carries an explicit evidence-strength record and transcript-derived workflow claims stay blocked.
rows.blocker_or_dependency: Requires explicit evidence-strength vocabulary and schema validation before compiled outputs refresh.
do_not_promote_notes: Transcript-derived workflow claims must remain blocked.

rows.validation_method: Validate that every compiled output names its consume inputs, merge rule, and policy gate before refresh.
rows.blocker_or_dependency: Requires stable compiled output paths and idempotent refresh scripts.
do_not_promote_notes: Compiled derivatives inherit bounded source-quality limits.

rows.validation_method: Validate the operational matrix against its schema and ensure each row names consume inputs, outputs, and non-promotion notes.
rows.blocker_or_dependency: Requires matrix rows to stay parent-owned and bounded to the consume-source-quality slice.
do_not_promote_notes: Operational rows describe compile behavior, not active runtime lanes.

rows.validation_method: Validate that extension guidance references current canonical matrix rows and does not mutate the bounded parent runtime truth.
rows.blocker_or_dependency: Requires the canonical capability matrix to remain the source of truth while guidance stays advisory.
do_not_promote_notes: Guidance does not rewrite the canonical capability matrix by itself.
